title: Hurt head, Delhi, 2023 (IPC) and 2024 (BNS): how much of the 2023 to 2024 fall it can account for
scope: Delhi as NCRB prints it (the 15 districts plus Crime Branch, Railway and other specialised units), registered cases.

national.status: As reported in the press from the NCRB Crime in India 2024 report; not re-derived here and the NCRB report itself was not read.
national.explanation: NCRB attributes the fall in hurt cases to the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita: hurt and grievous hurt sections were merged and simple hurt became a non-cognisable offence, so it no longer appears in police registration data.

caveats: The 2023 head is named "Hurt" and the 2024 head "Hurt or Grievous Hurt"; NCRB says the BNS merged these sections, so the two are not the same definition and the change is not a change in incidents.
The hurt change accounts for only a small part of Delhi's fall; theft accounts for most of it, and the national hurt explanation says nothing about theft.
Whether other heads moved because of reclassification has not been checked head by head.
